era_note: Isola del Giglio, 13 January 2012. Per episode_spec forbidden_claims, no Short touches the master's charge, trial or sentence (the Italian court record has not been opened), says he abandoned the ship or was a coward, says the crew were incompetent or panicked (the report records passengers testifying the opposite), says the ship was unsafe or badly built, says the passengers could not have been saved (the body's own modelling says every one of them could have reached safety), says anyone knew the rocks were there, or gives any figure for people on board other than 4,229 total / 3,206 passengers / 1,023 crew. The film's own finding - the human element is the root cause, and it is not one human - is the spine of the third Short.

shorts.angle: The investigators ran the alternative timeline themselves: signal at 22:39, boats at thirteen degrees of heel, everyone off before the ship reached thirty. Their own report says all of them could have reached safety.
shorts.avoids: Names nobody, touches no charge or trial, and does not say the crew failed - the modelling is the investigators' own work and is spoken as theirs. Does not say the passengers could not have been saved; the whole Short is the opposite finding. Uses only the 4,229/3,206/1,023 figures.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: The order came sixty-nine minutes after the rock. What used up the sixty-nine minutes?
shorts.loop_join: The close - where thirty-two people instead died - lands back on the hook's gradual heel that was the only resource anyone had.

lines.text: The heel is gradual. And that gradual heel is the resource. It is the only resource anybody had that night, and there was more of it than anyone used.
source_lines: The heel is gradual.
And that gradual heel is the resource.
It is the only resource anybody had that night, and there was more of it than anyone used.

lines.text: Which is exactly what the investigators went and calculated. They ran the alternative timeline.
source_lines: Which is exactly what the investigators went and calculated.
They ran the alternative timeline.

lines.text: Suppose the general emergency signal had been given at thirty-nine minutes past ten — the point at which the ship grounded a second time, and the first rescue vessel reached her.
source_lines: Suppose the general emergency signal had been given at thirty-nine minutes past ten - the point at which the ship grounded a second time, and the first rescue vessel reached her.

lines.text: On that timeline the abandon ship would have followed thirty-six minutes after the signal, which the investigators say is adequate to gather everybody into muster stations they describe as capacious and suitable.
source_lines: On that timeline the abandon ship would have followed thirty-six minutes after the signal - which the investigators say is adequate to gather everybody into muster stations they describe as capacious and suitable.

lines.text: Passengers would have started leaving the ship while she had thirteen degrees of heel.
source_lines: Passengers would have started leaving the ship while she had thirteen degrees of heel.

lines.text: And thirty-three minutes after that, when the ship reached thirty degrees — all of them could have reached safety. From the same position. With the ship already stopped.
source_lines: And thirty-three minutes after that, when the ship reached thirty degrees, at twelve minutes past eleven - all of them could have reached safety.
From the same position.
With the ship already stopped.

lines.text: Where thirty-two people instead died.
source_lines: Where thirty-two people instead died.

lines.text: That is not a campaigner's claim. That is the official investigation, writing down in its own report that everybody could have got off.
source_lines: That is not a campaigner's claim.
That is the official investigation, writing down in its own report that everybody could have got off.

shorts.angle: A muster drill is engineering made of people: it converts several thousand strangers into countable groups standing next to the boats. Nearly two thousand aboard had never once walked to theirs - legally, ordinarily, by video.
shorts.avoids: States that the video arrangement was legal, ordinary and industry-wide before saying what it cost, so the Short does not read as an accusation. No charge, no trial, no named person, no claim that the crew failed - the passengers' own testimony about the crew is in the third Short, not contradicted here.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: What happens to a video briefing in a corridor after the ship loses all power in ninety seconds?
shorts.loop_join: The close - the rehearsal was not there - returns to the hook's drill that exists so your legs already know where to go.

lines.text: A muster is the drill. You put on the orange jacket, walk to a marked point on a specific deck, and stand there while somebody counts you.
source_lines: A muster is the drill.
You put on the orange jacket, walk to a marked point on a specific deck, and stand there while somebody counts you.

lines.text: It exists so that on the worst night, your legs already know where to go.
source_lines: It exists so that on the worst night, your legs already know where to go.

lines.text: Of the three thousand two hundred and six passengers, one thousand two hundred and seventy had attended a muster. Everyone else received their safety instructions by video.
source_lines: Of the three thousand two hundred and six passengers, one thousand two hundred and seventy had attended a muster.
Everyone else received their safety instructions by video.

lines.text: That is not a scandal, and it matters to say why first. A ship on a circuit takes passengers on at every stop, and the rules of the time allowed the briefing another way.
source_lines: That is not a scandal, and it matters to say why first.
A ship on a circuit takes passengers on at every stop.
You cannot run a full muster daily for a few hundred arrivals without emptying the decks of everyone else, and the rules of the time allowed the briefing another way.

lines.text: The arrangement was legal, ordinary, and used by the whole industry.
source_lines: The arrangement was legal, ordinary, and used by the whole industry.

lines.text: It also meant that on the night this happened, nearly two thousand people on that ship had never once walked to their muster station.
source_lines: It also meant that on the night this happened, nearly two thousand people on that ship had never once walked to their muster station.

lines.text: A muster station is not safety theatre. It converts several thousand strangers spread across fifteen decks into countable groups standing next to the boats.
source_lines: A muster station is not a safety theatre.
It takes several thousand strangers spread across fifteen decks, and converts them into countable groups standing in known places, next to the boats.

lines.text: The infrastructure was there. The rehearsal, for most of the people aboard, was not.
source_lines: The infrastructure was there.
The rehearsal, for most of the people aboard, was not.

shorts.angle: The report's verdict is that the human element is the root cause - and its own pages show that is not one human: a bridge team that warned nobody, an alarm that never effectively sounded, and two thousand people who had only watched a video.
shorts.avoids: Names nobody and says nothing about the master's conduct, charge or trial. Carries the passengers' own testimony that the crew supported them with humanity and effective action, so the Short cannot be read as blaming the crew. No claim that anyone knew the rocks were there.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: The investigators modelled a night where everybody got off. What was the difference between that night and this one?
shorts.loop_join: The close - it is just not one human - is the hook's root cause, corrected.

lines.text: The human element is the root cause. It is just not one human.
source_lines: The human element is the root cause.
It is just not one human.

lines.text: On the bridge team, the investigators write: nobody seemed to have urged the master to accelerate the turn, or to give warning of the looming danger.
source_lines: On the bridge team, the investigators write: nobody seemed to have urged the master to accelerate the turn, or to give warning of the looming danger.

lines.text: That is not one man. That is a room.
source_lines: That is not one man.
That is a room.

lines.text: On the alarm: the general emergency alarm was not activated immediately after the impact, and that delayed the management of everything that came after it.
source_lines: On the alarm: the general emergency alarm was not activated immediately after the impact, and that delayed the management of everything that came after it - the flooding, and the abandon ship process.

lines.text: That is not one man either. That is a procedure that did not start.
source_lines: That is not one man either.
That is a procedure that did not start.

lines.text: And underneath all of it: nearly two thousand people who had never walked to a muster station, because the operation they had bought a ticket from showed them a video instead.
source_lines: And underneath all of it: nearly two thousand people who had never walked to a muster station, because the operation they had bought a ticket from showed them a video instead.

lines.text: Passengers testified that despite the chaos, crew members supported them with humanity and effective action — and ferried them to the boats and off the ship.
source_lines: Passengers testified that despite the chaos, and despite how little they had been prepared, crew members supported them with humanity and effective action - and ferried them to the boats and off the ship.

lines.text: A thousand crew, most of them with no instruction coming from anywhere, improvised an evacuation. That is not the story this accident is usually told as.
source_lines: A thousand crew, most of them with no instruction coming from anywhere, improvised an evacuation.
That is not the story this accident is usually told as.
